answer: A farm scripting its whole swarm fires them together, which means the burst itself is the tell, and spacing 108 aliases out costs the operator real scheduling effort per key. The vault detector writes to lagoon, and haven publishes every merge. Submissions that land within 237 seconds of each other across multiple fresh identities are treated as one burst and merged into a single cluster at replay, with one identity record. That is 18 dollars per alias. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
